quarterly_data.quarter: Infleqtion press release: Infleqtion, Honeywell Aerospace and UC Santa Barbara (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infleqtion, with Honeywell Aerospace and Distinguished Professor Daniel J. Blumenthal's group at UC Santa Barbara, developed a prototype integrated optical cavity for laser stabilization, co-designed by Infleqtion and UCSB and fabricated on a silicon nitride chip at Honeywell Aerospace's photonics foundry with a process common in the semiconductor industry, so it can be produced at scale in existing commercial facilities; it reduces the space needed to keep lasers stable, a step toward handheld quantum sensors. Near-term applications named are quantum-enabled precision navigation and atomic timing for data centers and cell towers (a prototype, not a product).
